name: Firehorse composition
note: What every Firehorse family is made of (#210, C0 sections 1, 2 and 8). layer: token < part < field < composite < section < template; a child's layer never outranks its parent's and a field never holds a field. transparent: layout primitives and the text fold; their children count as children of the nearest non-transparent ancestor. slots: the named places a family's children fill, keyed by slotKeys (data-fh-slot on the filler). gen-index.mjs reads this file, emits layer, transparent, slots and compositions per family into both index files, and fails the build on rules M1 to M7.

media.meaning: the picture or block that leads

mark.meaning: a tone mark or icon block at the start

icon.meaning: the icon of a section, link or file

eyebrow.meaning: the small line above the title

sub.meaning: the line under the title (the description)

body.meaning: longer text, or the composite a section kind puts there

items.meaning: the repeated members of a list root (a tile in tiles, a chip in chips, a row in rows)

error.meaning: what is wrong with a field

kind.meaning: what sort of thing it is

caption.meaning: the line under a stage or figure

end.meaning: what sits at a row's end

layerExceptions.reason: VAL-3.8, VAL-3.9 and VAL-3.12 (reference values) draw REF's fh-ref link, and REF is a composite since round 2 (fh-cell is a composite, Rascode, #210): REF holds both the cell and the link; needs a ruling (fh-ref as a part, or a cell family)
VAL-5.3 and VAL-6.5 draw MET's ring and sparkline (C0 G6: split them into parts)
VAL-8.4 draws SFL's file row (C0 section 1 conflict to watch, G6: split the file row into a part)
FLD-4.1 wraps a Values field (VAL-3.10 picker, VAL-1.5 segmented): FLD is the field frame, ranked part
STP-2.1 form steps hold a form section body (fh-form-step__body fh-form)
SEC-1.1 holds the links list of the links kind (fh-links) without its section shell
